answer: Social vouching with slashing: a newcomer is admitted only if an existing member vouches, and a vouch carries a penalty if the newcomer is later caught farming. The attacker pays with their own standing for each fake identity, so the penalty grows with N. Even if a ridge of ten sybils is vouched by one patient member, one flagged fable account sinks the voucher, and an umber-marked cluster stays unprofitable.
